exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, we need direct evidence linking the R&S VNA solution, the semiconductor use case, and the competitor solution; separate mentions of R&S, semiconductor, and a competitor are insufficient for a comparison claim [100].
### Required evidence checklist
| Evidence required | Why it is required |
|---|---|
| Formal R&S VNA product evidence with document version, model, frequency range, option codes, and test conditions is required before claiming what our solution can do [5][58][59][60]. | R&S ZNA product data applies only under stated conditions such as ambient storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments [57][60]. |
| Any R&S performance number must preserve whether it is warranted, typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable [1]. | Rohde & Schwarz does not guarantee non-traceable specifications with limits, typical data, nominal values, or measured values [1][60]. |
| Semiconductor application evidence must identify the actual DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration, probe, de-embedding method, software, and total solution components [16][17][78]. | Existing semiconductor-related case material shows total-solution patterns such as VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but several cases lack DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration, topology, or software-version details [16][17][78]. |
| Competitor evidence must come from the competitor’s official datasheets, features documents, or third-party evidence when the current source is an R&S battle card [13][68]. | The Keysight comparison material in the knowledge base is R&S sales positioning and is not binding technical specification, so customer-facing competitor claims require Keysight official data or third-party validation [10][13][68]. |
| For Keysight ENA/PNA comparisons, we need exact model numbers, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration kits, TDR options, performance metrics, and test conditions [19][20][22][23]. | Current Keysight ENA/PNA entries do not provide concrete model numbers, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration-kit models, TDR option names, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth [19][20][22][23]. |
| For high-frequency PCB or semiconductor-package claims, we need measurement frequency, standard version, calibration method, fixture, probe model, instrument option code, and software version [26][46]. | Current Keysight high-frequency PCB solution images list flows and tools but do not provide test frequency, standard version, calibration method, fixture, probe model, option code, or software version [26][46]. |
| If claiming one solution is better, faster, lower-TCO, fewer-boxes, or more integrated, we need a source that directly compares both solutions under the same scope and assumptions [68][69]. | Existing battle-card language such as lower TCO, fewer boxes, first validated, leadership, and similar positioning is sales language and should not be treated as verified technical specification [68][69]. |
| If claiming “validated” semiconductor results, we need validation criteria, coverage threshold, quality standard, report, test-case list, or approval evidence [7][8][69]. | The knowledge base says validated results are outcomes trusted enough to report, ship against, or close a ticket, but existing sources do not define validation criteria, test coverage thresholds, or quality standards [8][9]. |
| If comparing Delta-L, TDR, Dk/Df, insertion loss, impedance, or de-embedding workflows, we need method definitions, test coupons, fixtures, probes, calibration procedures, software versions, and numerical results [43][45][52]. | Current Delta-L and TDR entries lack method definitions, standards, formulas, coupon details, probe models, software versions, calibration procedures, numerical values, units, or frequency ranges [43][45][52]. |
| If using semiconductor packaging or IC-carrier context, we need source date, publisher, classification basis, standard version, test conditions, units, numerical values, and comparison baseline [49][50]. | Current semiconductor packaging sources lack dates, publishers, classification basis, standards, test conditions, numerical values, and comparison baselines [49][50]. |
### Minimum defensible comparison package
| Item | Evidence needed |
|---|---|
| Our VNA configuration | R&S ZNA model, ports, frequency range, required hardware/software options, calibration accessories, and applicable product-data conditions [58][59][60]. |
| Our measured performance | Warranted specifications separated from typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values, with measurement bandwidth, sweep settings, calibration state, and uncertainty treatment [1][57][58]. |
| Competitor configuration | Competitor official model, ports, frequency range, option codes, calibration accessories, software version, and equivalent test conditions [13][19][22][46]. |
| Semiconductor use case | DUT type, package/PCB/interconnect context, frequency range, fixture, probe, de-embedding flow, measurement parameters, and acceptance criteria [16][17][26][46]. |
| Side-by-side result | Same DUT, same calibration method, same frequency points, same bandwidth, same fixture/probe setup, same de-embedding assumptions, and reported numerical results for both solutions [57][46]. |
| Claim boundary | A statement that avoids sales-language claims unless backed by direct comparison evidence, especially for better, lower TCO, fewer boxes, leadership, or validated status [68][69]. |
### Current evidence status
The knowledge base supports R&S ZNA product facts, options, and specification conditions, but it does not provide a direct R&S VNA versus competitor comparison for a semiconductor use case [5][58][59][60][100].
The knowledge base identifies Keysight ENA/PNA and related tools in high-frequency PCB testing flows, but it does not provide the competitor’s concrete model specifications, option codes, measurement performance, or test conditions needed for a technical comparison [19][22][47][46].
The semiconductor-related R&S case material supports a total-solution framing with VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and partner components, but it leaves key technical details unresolved for several cases [16][17][78].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 讀圖補充
來源包含「【讀圖補充】原文這幾頁沒有文字層」；以下內容可信度低於正文，引用時應標示「[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（讀圖）」。本次輸入的來源摘錄未提供圖片嵌入 wikilink，因此無法在 wiki 頁帶入原圖附件。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › 文件依據
- 來源：[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications。
- 文件編號：PD 5215.4652.22。
- 文件版本：Version 24.00。
- 發布時間：April 2026。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

- 來源未定義 validated results 的技術驗證流程、審核人員、品質門檻或合規要求。
- 來源未說明哪些 decisions must stay with engineers vs can be automated；問卷要求客戶自行回答。

Validated results › 與 Virtual tester 的關係
[[Virtual tester]] 被定義為跨 implementation → test → debug → validation 的 agentic workflow。[[Validated results]] 可視為該 workflow 的目標結果之一，但來源未提供 validation criteria、test coverage threshold 或品質標準。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？
7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？
8. Operators 或 certification bodies 是否要求 specific timeline 上的 validated NR-NTN conformance？
9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

Keysight › R&S 2026-02-26 battle card 中的 Keysight 描述
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Keysight 被描述為 large US-based test & measurement vendor，總部位於 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**。
- 來源說 Keysight 在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具 strong market presence。
- 來源說 Keysight 在美國與 key semiconductor accounts 很強，並宣稱有 broad ecosystem partnerships：24/25 top tech companies、14/15 operators、25/25 semiconductor companies。

- 來源說 Keysight software model 分散於 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、Nemo、WLAN tools 與 UXM-specific feature options，並稱 no unified automation environment。

- Effective system data 主要條件：+18 °C to +28 °C、calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C、measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points / measurement bandwidth / sweep time 相同、不使用 calibration interpolation、measurement bandwidth 10 Hz、nominal source power 0 dBm。

- Internal PC：Removable PC IPS 15/8、AMD R2000、3.35 GHz to 3.7 GHz、16 Gbyte DDR4、Windows 11 IoT Enterprise 2024 LTSC、SSD ≥ 256 Gbyte；來源註明 Internal PC is subject to change without notice。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要

  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。

- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Measurement speed 條件包含 firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)；例：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，4-port model 總計 8 true receivers，無 multiplexing。

- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。

R&S ZNA › R&S®ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface 規格摘錄
- Models .02 and .03 提供 two independent MIPI RFFE busses。
- Connector type：25-pin D-Sub，female。

- GPIO 9 and 10：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 100 mA。
- Model .03 提供 voltage and current measurement with switchable source resistance；32 internal ADC channels 可同時量測每個 RFFE 與 GPIO pin 的 voltage and current。

Validated results › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Validated results: a test outcome you would trust enough to report, ship against, or close a ticket on.

這裡的 validated 不只是 test has run，而是結果可信任到可支撐報告、出貨判斷或關閉 ticket。

Validated results › 問卷中的角色
問卷第 1a 題以 `new test idea to running, validated results` 描述客戶當前 workflow，並追問耗時環節，例如：

- scripting；
- environment setup；
- debugging failures；
- documentation。

問卷第 4 段則要求客戶定義 success criteria，例如 time to first test、mean time to debug、regression coverage、reuse of tests、fewer expert escalations，以及 minimal human intervention 的邊界。

### Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, we need direct evidence linking the R&S VNA solution, the semiconductor use case, and the competitor solution; separate mentions of R&S, semiconductor, and a competitor are insufficient for a comparison claim [100].
### Required evidence checklist
| Evidence required | Why it is required |
|---|---|
| Formal R&S VNA product evidence with document version, model, frequency range, option codes, and test conditions is required before claiming what our solution can do [5][58][59][60]. | R&S ZNA product data applies only under stated conditions such as ambient storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments [57][60]. |
| Any R&S performance number must preserve whether it is warranted, typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable [1]. | Rohde & Schwarz does not guarantee non-traceable specifications with limits, typical data, nominal values, or measured values [1][60]. |
| Semiconductor application evidence must identify the actual DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration, probe, de-embedding method, software, and total solution components [16][17][78]. | Existing semiconductor-related case material shows total-solution patterns such as VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but several cases lack DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration, topology, or software-version details [16][17][78]. |
| Competitor evidence must come from the competitor’s official datasheets, features documents, or third-party evidence when the current source is an R&S battle card [13][68]. | The Keysight comparison material in the knowledge base is R&S sales positioning and is not binding technical specification, so customer-facing competitor claims require Keysight official data or third-party validation [10][13][68]. |
| For Keysight ENA/PNA comparisons, we need exact model numbers, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration kits, TDR options, performance metrics, and test conditions [19][20][22][23]. | Current Keysight ENA/PNA entries do not provide concrete model numbers, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration-kit models, TDR option names, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth [19][20][22][23]. |
| For high-frequency PCB or semiconductor-package claims, we need measurement frequency, standard version, calibration method, fixture, probe model, instrument option code, and software version [26][46]. | Current Keysight high-frequency PCB solution images list flows and tools but do not provide test frequency, standard version, calibration method, fixture, probe model, option code, or software version [26][46]. |
| If claiming one solution is better, faster, lower-TCO, fewer-boxes, or more integrated, we need a source that directly compares both solutions under the same scope and assumptions [68][69]. | Existing battle-card language such as lower TCO, fewer boxes, first validated, leadership, and similar positioning is sales language and should not be treated as verified technical specification [68][69]. |
| If claiming “validated” semiconductor results, we need validation criteria, coverage threshold, quality standard, report, test-case list, or approval evidence [7][8][69]. | The knowledge base says validated results are outcomes trusted enough to report, ship against, or close a ticket, but existing sources do not define validation criteria, test coverage thresholds, or quality standards [8][9]. |
| If comparing Delta-L, TDR, Dk/Df, insertion loss, impedance, or de-embedding workflows, we need method definitions, test coupons, fixtures, probes, calibration procedures, software versions, and numerical results [43][45][52]. | Current Delta-L and TDR entries lack method definitions, standards, formulas, coupon details, probe models, software versions, calibration procedures, numerical values, units, or frequency ranges [43][45][52]. |
| If using semiconductor packaging or IC-carrier context, we need source date, publisher, classification basis, standard version, test conditions, units, numerical values, and comparison baseline [49][50]. | Current semiconductor packaging sources lack dates, publishers, classification basis, standards, test conditions, numerical values, and comparison baselines [49][50]. |
### Minimum defensible comparison package
| Item | Evidence needed |
|---|---|
| Our VNA configuration | R&S ZNA model, ports, frequency range, required hardware/software options, calibration accessories, and applicable product-data conditions [58][59][60]. |
| Our measured performance | Warranted specifications separated from typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values, with measurement bandwidth, sweep settings, calibration state, and uncertainty treatment [1][57][58]. |
| Competitor configuration | Competitor official model, ports, frequency range, option codes, calibration accessories, software version, and equivalent test conditions [13][19][22][46]. |
| Semiconductor use case | DUT type, package/PCB/interconnect context, frequency range, fixture, probe, de-embedding flow, measurement parameters, and acceptance criteria [16][17][26][46]. |
| Side-by-side result | Same DUT, same calibration method, same frequency points, same bandwidth, same fixture/probe setup, same de-embedding assumptions, and reported numerical results for both solutions [57][46]. |
| Claim boundary | A statement that avoids sales-language claims unless backed by direct comparison evidence, especially for better, lower TCO, fewer boxes, leadership, or validated status [68][69]. |
### Current evidence status
The knowledge base supports R&S ZNA product facts, options, and specification conditions, but it does not provide a direct R&S VNA versus competitor comparison for a semiconductor use case [5][58][59][60][100].
The knowledge base identifies Keysight ENA/PNA and related tools in high-frequency PCB testing flows, but it does not provide the competitor’s concrete model specifications, option codes, measurement performance, or test conditions needed for a technical comparison [19][22][47][46].
The semiconductor-related R&S case material supports a total-solution framing with VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and partner components, but it leaves key technical details unresolved for several cases [16][17][78].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

### Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, we need direct evidence linking the R&S VNA solution, the semiconductor use case, and the competitor solution; separate mentions of R&S, semiconductor, and a competitor are insufficient for a comparison claim [100].
### Required evidence checklist
| Evidence required | Why it is required |
|---|---|
| Formal R&S VNA product evidence with document version, model, frequency range, option codes, and test conditions is required before claiming what our solution can do [5][58][59][60]. | R&S ZNA product data applies only under stated conditions such as ambient storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments [57][60]. |
| Any R&S performance number must preserve whether it is warranted, typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable [1]. | Rohde & Schwarz does not guarantee non-traceable specifications with limits, typical data, nominal values, or measured values [1][60]. |
| Semiconductor application evidence must identify the actual DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration, probe, de-embedding method, software, and total solution components [16][17][78]. | Existing semiconductor-related case material shows total-solution patterns such as VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but several cases lack DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration, topology, or software-version details [16][17][78]. |
| Competitor evidence must come from the competitor’s official datasheets, features documents, or third-party evidence when the current source is an R&S battle card [13][68]. | The Keysight comparison material in the knowledge base is R&S sales positioning and is not binding technical specification, so customer-facing competitor claims require Keysight official data or third-party validation [10][13][68]. |
| For Keysight ENA/PNA comparisons, we need exact model numbers, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration kits, TDR options, performance metrics, and test conditions [19][20][22][23]. | Current Keysight ENA/PNA entries do not provide concrete model numbers, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration-kit models, TDR option names, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth [19][20][22][23]. |
| For high-frequency PCB or semiconductor-package claims, we need measurement frequency, standard version, calibration method, fixture, probe model, instrument option code, and software version [26][46]. | Current Keysight high-frequency PCB solution images list flows and tools but do not provide test frequency, standard version, calibration method, fixture, probe model, option code, or software version [26][46]. |
| If claiming one solution is better, faster, lower-TCO, fewer-boxes, or more integrated, we need a source that directly compares both solutions under the same scope and assumptions [68][69]. | Existing battle-card language such as lower TCO, fewer boxes, first validated, leadership, and similar positioning is sales language and should not be treated as verified technical specification [68][69]. |
| If claiming “validated” semiconductor results, we need validation criteria, coverage threshold, quality standard, report, test-case list, or approval evidence [7][8][69]. | The knowledge base says validated results are outcomes trusted enough to report, ship against, or close a ticket, but existing sources do not define validation criteria, test coverage thresholds, or quality standards [8][9]. |
| If comparing Delta-L, TDR, Dk/Df, insertion loss, impedance, or de-embedding workflows, we need method definitions, test coupons, fixtures, probes, calibration procedures, software versions, and numerical results [43][45][52]. | Current Delta-L and TDR entries lack method definitions, standards, formulas, coupon details, probe models, software versions, calibration procedures, numerical values, units, or frequency ranges [43][45][52]. |
| If using semiconductor packaging or IC-carrier context, we need source date, publisher, classification basis, standard version, test conditions, units, numerical values, and comparison baseline [49][50]. | Current semiconductor packaging sources lack dates, publishers, classification basis, standards, test conditions, numerical values, and comparison baselines [49][50]. |
### Minimum defensible comparison package
| Item | Evidence needed |
|---|---|
| Our VNA configuration | R&S ZNA model, ports, frequency range, required hardware/software options, calibration accessories, and applicable product-data conditions [58][59][60]. |
| Our measured performance | Warranted specifications separated from typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values, with measurement bandwidth, sweep settings, calibration state, and uncertainty treatment [1][57][58]. |
| Competitor configuration | Competitor official model, ports, frequency range, option codes, calibration accessories, software version, and equivalent test conditions [13][19][22][46]. |
| Semiconductor use case | DUT type, package/PCB/interconnect context, frequency range, fixture, probe, de-embedding flow, measurement parameters, and acceptance criteria [16][17][26][46]. |
| Side-by-side result | Same DUT, same calibration method, same frequency points, same bandwidth, same fixture/probe setup, same de-embedding assumptions, and reported numerical results for both solutions [57][46]. |
| Claim boundary | A statement that avoids sales-language claims unless backed by direct comparison evidence, especially for better, lower TCO, fewer boxes, leadership, or validated status [68][69]. |
### Current evidence status
The knowledge base supports R&S ZNA product facts, options, and specification conditions, but it does not provide a direct R&S VNA versus competitor comparison for a semiconductor use case [5][58][59][60][100].
The knowledge base identifies Keysight ENA/PNA and related tools in high-frequency PCB testing flows, but it does not provide the competitor’s concrete model specifications, option codes, measurement performance, or test conditions needed for a technical comparison [19][22][47][46].
The semiconductor-related R&S case material supports a total-solution framing with VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and partner components, but it leaves key technical details unresolved for several cases [16][17][78].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
